article:
Jenny Blatchford, the talented young sculptor, was born in the south - west of England in 1989. She is the daughter of a doctor, and the family lived in a number of different towns when Jenny was a child. 16______ However, there were some advantages; she says it gave her the ability to become used to new environments very quickly.
Her earliest memories are of playing with her primary school friends on the outskirts of a city where workers were building lots of new apartment blocks. 17______ The amount of skill involved impressed her greatly, and Jenny says that this early experience led her to become interested in sculpture.
She was a clever student and went to a very good school. It was a wonderful place to study science and languages, but not art. 18______ In fact, most of the staff thought it was something pupils were either good or bad at, and didn't need special instruction. Luckily one of her teachers recognised Jenny's talent and gave her art lessons in the evenings after school.
No - one was surprised when Jenny chose to apply to study art at college. She had the opportunity to develop her skills in sculpture, creating huge statues of animals, mainly out of materials such as wood, stone and metal. 19______ Recently she has even started to make them out of paper. Some of her sculptures are extremely realistic, but others are unusually shaped. Art experts love her originality and she has won many awards and prizes.
Jenny gets her ideas for her sculptures in a number of different ways. 20______ She also likes to look at other people's art. She says the most important thing is that she is excited by each new project.

sentences.label: A
sentences.text: Sometimes they come from spending time outdoors.

sentences.label: B
sentences.text: This meant that she didn't have the chance to get to know anywhere very well.

sentences.label: C
sentences.text: In spite of this, she is influencing a lot of young artists.

sentences.label: D
sentences.text: Unfortunately, little time was spent there on teaching it.

sentences.label: E
sentences.text: She loved moving around, and made many new friends.

sentences.label: F
sentences.text: However, she also enjoyed trying to use other things, like glass.

sentences.label: G
sentences.text: All subjects were taught very well, and Jenny learned quickly.

sentences.label: H
sentences.text: She loved watching as each new floor was added.

explanations.16: Jenny童年搬家多次，B选项“This meant that she didn't have the chance to get to know anywhere very well.”（因此无法深入了解某地）说明搬家的影响，与“lived in a number of different towns”呼应。
explanations.17: 童年记忆是看工人建房，H选项“She loved watching as each new floor was added.”（喜欢看楼层搭建）具体描述兴趣，与“building lots of new apartment blocks”衔接。
explanations.18: 学校擅长科学语言但非艺术，D选项“Unfortunately, little time was spent there on teaching it.”（不幸的是艺术课少）补充现状，与“most of the staff thought it was something pupils were either good or bad at”呼应。
explanations.19: Jenny用木材、石头等材料创作，F选项“However, she also enjoyed trying to use other things, like glass.”（也尝试玻璃等材料）扩展材料类型，与“recently started to make them out of paper”并列。
explanations.20: 创作灵感来源多样，A选项“Sometimes they come from spending time outdoors.”（有时来自户外）举例说明，与“also likes to look at other people's art”并列。
